name: What can go wrong when repairing the inside of a foreclosed house?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong when repairing the inside of a foreclosed house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risks are hidden water damage, mold, electrical problems, pests, and unsafe debris. Foreclosed properties can also have abandoned chemicals, broken glass, or damaged subfloors, so a rushed repair can turn a manageable job into a larger restoration project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hidden damage, mold, pests, unsafe debris, and electrical problems are the main risks. A rushed job can make the repair more expensive and less safe.
